'''Casserole''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Nerf casserole]] was made with [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]], and its flavor could be enhanced with dried [[vohis mold]].<ref name="Platt's">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] had a type of casserole called [[Tiingilar/Legends|''tiingilar'']].<ref name="Order 66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

A casserole was made for the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], his [[Chewbacca's family/Legends|family]], and his guests to [[Diet/Legends|consume]] at his [[Standard century/Legends|two hundredth]] [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a particularly successful casserole was made by [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]], the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] at the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Goatgrass" />

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Casserole first appeared in the [[1979]] children's book ''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]'', which was written by [[Eleanor Ehrhardt]] and illustrated by [[Patricia Wynne]].<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook" />
